items.title: Citigroup (C) Could Be 15% Undervalued As It Expands Citi Token Services
items.summary: Citigroup (C) just took a visible step in digital finance by expanding its Citi Token Services into Japan and the UAE while deepening a collaboration with Coinbase to let institutional clients accept stablecoin payments. For all this activity in digital payments, Citigroup’s recent share price momentum has cooled, with the stock down over the past week and quarter, even as the year-to-date share price return sits in double digits and the 1-year total shareholder return is close to 30%. items.title: Optics Stocks Slide Despite Citi’s $11B Switching Forecast: Coherent and Applied Optoelectronics Drop 5%, Corning Falls 3%
items.summary: Citi just painted a picture of an $11 billion optical switching market, yet Coherent, Applied Optoelectronics, and Corning are all falling sharply with no bad news in sight. Something else is driving this selloff, and it says a lot about where these stocks really stand.
